newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-DENILSON SIGNING COULD BE DELAYED.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DENILSON SIGNING COULD BE DELAYED.

text.p: Real Madrid said on Tuesday that the signing of Brazilian striker Denilson from Sao Paulo could be delayed until December.
A Real Madrid official said the club feared that Sao Paulo president Fernando Casal de Rey might delay further negotiations until after his club's elections later this year.
Denilson, 19, was one of the outstanding players in the Brazil team which won the Copa America last month.
